newsitem.title: UK: Railtrack at record on investment plan.
newsitem.headline: Railtrack at record on investment plan.

text.p: Shares in Railtrack Group Plc rose to a record high on Friday following the company's 15.9 billion stg investment plan announced on Thursday,.
Railtrack shares were 13-1/2p higher at 436p by 1007 GMT after earlier rising as high as 439p, surpassing the previous peak of 429p set on January 16. Volume reached 1.9 million shares.
"There was a follow-on from yesterday's announcement," said one dealer.

The railway infrastructure company said yesterday it would invest 8.3 billion stg on renewal investments over the next ten years, as well as 5.7 billion stg on day-to-day maintenance and 1.9 billion stg on network enhancement.
The company had previously been criticised by the rail regulator for under-investing.
